name: Scope extensions
plain: An installed app can claim several websites as part of itself.
meaning: Links to those origins open inside the app window instead of the browser. Each origin has to agree through a file on its own server.

access.prompt_ui: None, the other origin opts in by file

chrome.note: Desktop and Android per the compat data

data.metric: An installed app can claim several websites as part of itself.

limits.headline: Can make several sites behave as one installed app, if each site agrees
limits.user_action: None, the page reads it silently
can: Keep links to a partner or sibling domain inside the app window
Share one installed identity across sites
cannot: Claim an origin that did not publish the association file
Work in Safari, Firefox or on phones

story.what_it_is: One installed app can stretch across more than one website address.

marketing.name: Scope extensions for PWAs
marketing.pitch: Lets a PWA span multiple origins as one app.

story.for_you: Links between a company's sites stay in one app window instead of jumping to a browser tab.
story.for_makers: Makers who run a brand across several domains keep one app feel.

use_cases.example: A suite spreads its tools across a few subdomains but runs as one installed app.

risks: Blurs which site you are on

technical_bounds: Each origin must publish an association file

abuse: Hiding the real domain behind app chrome
